description.value: Ichiro Japanese Restaurant is a Japanese-owned and operated full-service restaurant in Steveston Fisherman Village, serving authentic washoku cuisine since 2006. The restaurant is notable for its exceptional sashimi quality — it is reportedly the only sushi restaurant in the Vancouver area using a specialty -60°C freezer — and imports fresh fish and Wagyu beef directly from Japan. Steveston is a well-known cycling destination in Richmond, making this a potential rest stop for cyclists exploring the Steveston waterfront.
